content: Wch'alal je atch-on rmal Dios, anen ja en anciano quentak ela jawra carta chawa, y quentak ela chca awal chka'. Anen congan quixnwajo', per jun ojben ri'il jc'ola kuq'uin ne ktzij wa' chruq'uin Jesucristo penak wa'. Per mnuyon ta anen quixnwajo' per nquixcajo' chka' conjelal jch'obtanak cmal nak rbanic utzlaj tijonem rxin Jesucristo.
Rmal utzlaj tijonem jrec'mon ta Jesucristo rmal c'ara' tak quixnwajo', jara' tijonem c'o chic ptak kanm y nec'je' na kuq'uin rxin junlic.

Jutzil je nsipaj Dios chka, jara' ta xtyataja chewa rmal Dios Ttixel y rmal Kajaw Jesucristo je Rlec'wal Kadta' Dios, j-e' ta xtecpoknaj ewech y xtqueya' ta chewa che qui'il nec'je'a ewanm. Jara' nekcochij tzra Dios tak nec'je'a utzlaj tijonem rxin Jesucristo ptak kanm y tak nkajo' ki' chka'.
Ec'ola awal kac'lun ki' kuq'uin y congan quenquicota chquij com j-e' quemjom wa' rnimaxic utzlaj tijonem rxin Jesucristo. Ncara' quemjon rbanic ajni' nbij mandamiento je y-on chka rmal Ttixel.
Camic wch'alal, congan quenwajo' quenbij chewa che kaj-o' je' ki'. Per jawra mjun ta mandamiento c'ac' xwankera, per jawra bitanak ta chka nabey che nc'atzin wa' nkajo' je' ki'.
Je ojben ri'il rxin Dios cawra rbanic ra: jara' nanimaj je' mandamiento je y-on chka rmal Dios. Cawra mandamiento rey-on cana Dios ajni' ewc'axan ta nabey: twaj-o' je' ewi', cara' nbij.

Cara' quenbij chawa com e q'uiy e bnoy tak engaño e'elnak chic, ebnak cuq'uin wnak je xruq'uin rwech ruch'lew ykul wa' quec'u'x. J-era' wnak necpoknaj necbij che xkaj ta Jesucristo y xoca wnak. Achnak nebnowa cara' arja' xe bnoy engaño y ntzelaj Cristo.
Kas tebna' cwent ewi' y me tquixba'n ta engañar, mquita xtetz'ila' rtojbalil jsamaj jebnon, per kas quenwajo' chewa xtyataj tna chewa rtojbalil per nche njelal.
Wc'ola jun nuya' rwá' jtijonem rxin Cristo y wnuya' cana kas mer rbeyal, jara' majo'n Dios pranm. We nmajo'n naya' cta kas mer tijonem rxin Cristo jara' c'ola Ttixel chpam awanm rexbil Rlec'walxel.
Chka bechnak opech nekaja ewq'uin, wc'ola jun tijonem rec'mon ta je junwa' chwech tijonem rxin Cristo mtec'ul ta chpam ewuchoch chneya' repsad, y mtebij ta tzra: —Dios ta xtebnowa bendecir atijonem.
Cara' quenbij chewa com wc'ola jun nbij tzra: —Dios ta xtebnowa bendecir atijonem, jara' arja' jun nejklena ruq'uin itzel tijonem jnuya'.

C'c'o na más quenwajo' quenbij chewa per majo'n quentz'ibaj ta chpam carta, com jnech'bon anen che quenba na ewq'uin. Tak xtnekaja nutz'et ri' kawech ewq'uin, tzra' c'ara' xtoktzijon wa' ch-utz c'ara' nq'uiya y nwachina quicotemal rxin Dios ptak kanm.
Jral awch'alal jech-on rmal Dios arj-e' nquetak ela rutzil awech. Amén.
